Author: alizea1337
Name: Keystroke
Punchline: Automates Keybound Brawler typing with humanized input, auto-queue and reward tracking.
Description: Keystroke reads Keybound Brawler prompts and types the answers for you, with humanized timing by default and an optional instant mode. Auto-queue loops with stop conditions, opens Keybound Coffers, tracks MGP/MGC gains, warns before the MGC cap, and offers global hotkeys and a compact in-duty overlay. Open /keystroke to get started.
Changelog:
First stable release. Everything from the 0.1.0 testing build, verified in play: typing,
targeting, Cursed Gaze / Sensory Jammer pauses, auto-queue and commence, auto-leave, rewards
tracking, alerts, overlay and anti-AFK.

- Fix: wrong words are cleared with Esc instead of backspacing.
- Skilled profile raised to about 105 WPM.
- Uses the current Dalamud object API (BaseId).
